'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Chris Schoenthal DS Coruscant: Chancellor's Office''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Chancellor's Office|VB5-D-coruscantchancellorsoffice-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' You Said You'd Never Forget
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
